description: sig.gencat.cat: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.gencat.cat. Coverage: the area served by sig.gencat.cat. The listing groups 14 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Reserves naturals fluvials; Cartografia de les inundacions del Temporal Glòria de Gener 2020 - Ele; Delimitació de la zona inundable de T 100 anys, del Districte de conca; Delimitació de la zona inundable de T 500 anys, del Districte de conca. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
